context: Tech futures lead a higher open as Micron's AI outlook and Google's Gemini 4 lift sentiment, with PCE inflation data ahead.

items.why: Google unveils its new Gemini 4 Argon AI model.
items.sentiment: Stock rises on the new AI model release.
items.judge_note: Multiple publishers (Barron's, IBD, TradingView, Yahoo, Benzinga) confirm both the unveiling and the stock rise.

items.why: Nasdaq futures rise as Micron's strong earnings boost tech stocks.
items.sentiment: Tech leads the market higher before the bell.
items.judge_note: Investing.com and Bloomberg together link Nasdaq futures / tech stocks rising to Micron's strong earnings.

items.why: Amazon signs a nuclear power deal with Constellation Energy.
items.sentiment: Stock rises on the Amazon nuclear deal.
items.judge_note: Multiple publishers (Investing.com, TradingView, AD HOC NEWS, Barron's) confirm Amazon-Constellation nuclear deal and stock rising on it.

items.sentiment: Stock sits near a 52-week low before results.
items.judge_note: h168 (Stocks Down Under) explicitly says 'Earnings Today'; h174 (Investing.com India) says 'Nike to report' in a same-day market wrap. h167 does not mention 52-week low, so excluded from sentiment support.

dropped.why: NASA awards Rocket Lab two new missions and an Air Force contract.
dropped.sentiment: Stock rises on multiple new space deals.
drop: judge: h18 (NASA missions) and h20 (Air Force contract) are both Stocktwits — same publisher — so the combined claim lacks two distinct publishers.
